blinkless scroll and triggers

Twenty-seven styles. Scroll the page. Each block names the styles it shows.

1. scroll-timeline, scroll-timeline-name, scroll-timeline-axis

The root bar at the top of the page names a page scroll timeline. The host turns scroll offset into bar width.

scroll filler so the page is tall enough for scroll progress

2. view-timeline, view-timeline-name, view-timeline-axis, view-timeline-inset

Each card reports how far it has moved through the viewport.

card 1 view-timeline inset 20px 10px
card 2 view-timeline inset auto
card 3 longhands: name, axis x, inset 5%
scroll filler so the page is tall enough for scroll progress

3. timeline-scope

The scope box hoists a timeline declared inside it, so descendants of the scope box can read it by name.

scope-root: timeline-scope --scoped
scope-card declares --scoped
scope-reader reads --scoped as a descendant of scope-root
trigger longhands: name, source, activation start and end, active start and end
scroll filler so the page is tall enough for scroll progress

4. pointer-timeline, pointer-timeline-name, pointer-timeline-axis

Move the pointer over the box. The host maps pointer position to progress.

pointer-timeline: --ptr x
pointer-timeline-name and -axis
scroll filler so the page is tall enough for scroll progress

5. timeline-trigger and its name, source, ranges

The trigger turns on when the named timeline enters the activation range and stays on inside the active range.

timeline-trigger shorthand
activation-range and active-range pairs
scroll filler so the page is tall enough for scroll progress

6. event-trigger, event-trigger-name, event-trigger-source

Click the button, then press a key. The host arms the trigger.

event-trigger: --press click
event-trigger-name and -source: click / keydown
scroll filler so the page is tall enough for scroll progress

7. interest-delay, interest-delay-start, interest-delay-end

Hover a card. Interest starts after the first delay and clears after the second.

interest-delay: 200ms 500ms
interest-delay-start 100ms, interest-delay-end 300ms
scroll filler so the page is tall enough for scroll progress

8. interactivity

The inert panel takes no pointer hits and no focus. The auto panel does.

interactivity: inert
interactivity: auto
